verdict.rationale: Isaac GR00T is documented as an open reference platform for building, training, testing and deploying AI-powered humanoid robots, with generalist foundation models covering grasping, bimanual and multi-step tasks. Community discussion confirms the GR00T N1 model was released under Apache 2. Separately, Isaac ROS and Isaac Lab provide deployable perception packages and policy-training tooling. However, the pack never shows how a GR00T or other VLA model is actually wired into a robot's autonomy stack, such as a ROS 2 node or an inference or deployment path. Missing for 10: documented tooling for integrating VLA/foundation-model inference into ROS 2 or the autonomy stack, fine-tuning/deployment workflow docs for GR00T, support for third-party VLA models, and hands-on corroboration of a successful integration.
